Based on the medical history provided, Paul faces an elevated risk for prostate cancer due to his family history. Having a brother with prostate cancer, particularly when diagnosed at a similar age, suggests a potential genetic predisposition or shared environmental factors that increase susceptibility. While Paul’s healthy lifestyle—balanced diet and regular physical activity—is protective and beneficial for overall health, it does not eliminate the increased risk associated with his familial history. Therefore, he should adhere to recommended screening protocols, such as regular PSA testing and digital rectal exams, as advised by his healthcare provider, to monitor for any changes or progression of the disease.

The primary material of a candle is typically wax. Common types of wax include paraffin wax (derived from petroleum), beeswax (produced by honey bees), soy wax (made from soybean oil), and palm wax. The wax serves as the fuel source that melts and is drawn up the wick to sustain the flame.
